source_documents.title: Kenya National Cancer Screening and Early Diagnosis Guidelines - Cervical Cancer

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Cervical cancer screening program: screen women in the target age group and treat detected precancerous lesions.
functional_requirements.i_want: to screen women in the target age group and treat detected precancerous lesions
functional_requirements.so_that: the majority of cervical cancers can be prevented
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system supports recording screening and treatment for women in the target age group and links positive screens to treatment.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from the key message on screening and treatment; not a verbatim system requirement.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Screening all women in the target age group, followed by treatment of detected precancerous lesions, can prevent the majority of cervical cancers.

_derivation.explanation: Converted the normative screening-and-treatment message into a testable system capability requirement.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Screening strategy selection: choose HPV, VIA or cytology based on availability, loss-to-follow-up risk, age and context.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to help me choose the appropriate screening method
functional_requirements.so_that: the client receives a feasible and guideline-concordant screening approach
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can present HPV as primary screening and offer VIA or cytology when HPV is unavailable or loss-to-follow-up risk is high, with age-based routing.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from age-based flowchart and screening-method recommendations.

section_path: Clinician algorithm for choice of screening test
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: HPV testing is recommended as the primary screening method for women above 30 years of age
Where HPV testing is not yet available, or loss-to-follow-up is a risk, then VIA is an acceptable primary screening method.

section_path: Who should be screened and when?
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: In Kenya, for programmatic purposes, the target population for screening is every woman aged 25 – 49 years

_derivation.explanation: Combined age, availability and loss-to-follow-up guidance into a single user-facing capability.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: HPV screening workflow: record HPV test result and route HPV-negative clients to no further treatment/evaluation.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to record HPV results and apply the correct next step
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: When HPV result is negative, the system records no treatment and no further evaluation in the HPV screen-and-treat pathway.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: women who are HPV-negative are not treated, nor evaluated further

_derivation.explanation: Translated the HPV-negative pathway into a system requirement for routing and documentation.

functional_requirements.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: HPV-positive triage workflow: assess eligibility for ablative treatment using VIA/visual evaluation and route ineligible clients to excision or further evaluation.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to support triage of HPV-positive clients
functional_requirements.so_that: eligible clients can be treated and ineligible clients referred appropriately
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: For HPV-positive clients, the system supports triage with VIA/visual evaluation and records referral when ablative treatment is not eligible.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme

section_path: Fig 7: Algorithm for primary screening with HPV test
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Women who are HPV-positive should all be treated but first eligibility for ablative treatment must be assessed through the application of acetic acid and visual evaluation
Those who are ineligible for ablative treatment should be referred for excisional treatment or further evaluation.

_derivation.explanation: Combined triage, eligibility assessment and referral logic into one capability.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Single-visit service delivery: attempt to complete screening, triage and treatment in one visit where practical.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to support same-visit screening, triage and treatment
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The workflow can be configured to support same-visit completion of screening, triage and treatment when practical.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from the single-visit approach statement.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Implement a screen-triage-and-treat strategy for efficient management, in a single-visit approach if practical.

_derivation.explanation: Converted the operational preference for single-visit care into a workflow requirement.

functional_requirements.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Referral workflow: immediately refer suspected cancer cases to a gynecologic oncologist for diagnosis and treatment.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to trigger immediate referral for suspected cancer
functional_requirements.so_that: clients receive timely diagnosis and treatment
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: When suspected cancer is recorded, the system generates an immediate referral to gynecologic oncology and records the referral reason.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from referral statements in key messages and management sections.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Any suspected cancer case after screening should be immediately referred to a gynecologic oncologist for diagnosis and treatment.
ALL women suspected to be having cancer should be referred immediately for colposcopy with biopsy and further management by a gynecologic oncologist.

_derivation.explanation: Merged immediate referral instructions into a single referral capability.

functional_requirements.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Health information system linkage: ensure positive screening results are linked to treatment and follow-up.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to track positive screens through treatment
functional_requirements.so_that: the programme has a fail-safe mechanism against loss to follow-up
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can identify positive screens that have not yet linked to treatment and flag them for follow-up.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / health information system team
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from the fail-safe mechanism statement.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: The health information system should be strengthened to ensure an effective fail-safe mechanism (linkage to treatment for those testing positive)

_derivation.explanation: Converted the health information system strengthening statement into a traceable digital follow-up requirement.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Sample collection workflow: support provider-collected and self-collected HPV samples with instructions and transport handling.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to support HPV sample collection options
functional_requirements.so_that: screening can be done in facility and community settings
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can record provider-collected and self-collected HPV sampling and capture that collection and transport instructions were provided.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from sample collection guidance and service delivery recommendations.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: A health-care provider can collect a sample with or without a speculum
Self-collected samples provide women with a sample-collection kit and usage instructions

section_path: Recommendations for screening in special populations
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Community and facility based self- or provider-collected options with well-defined collection and transportation of specimens

_derivation.explanation: Combined provider and self-collection guidance into a single workflow requirement.

functional_requirements.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: VIA workflow: support VIA preparation, interpretation, documentation and referral when suspicious findings are present.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to guide and record VIA steps
functional_requirements.so_that: VIA is performed consistently and suspicious findings are escalated
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can record VIA preparation, result interpretation, documentation of findings and referral for suspicious cancer findings.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from VIA method and procedure steps.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: VIA is a method for detecting early cell changes ... after applying 5% acetic acid
Document your findings
If the cervix shows any unusual signs or the provider suspects cancer, a punch biopsy should be collected or the patient can be referred

_derivation.explanation: Combined VIA procedural steps and escalation criteria into one capability.

functional_requirements.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Cytology workflow: support specimen collection, lab transport, laboratory processing and Bethesda classification.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to support cytology specimen handling and result classification
functional_requirements.so_that: abnormal cytology can be identified and managed appropriately
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can record cytology collection, transport, laboratory processing and Bethesda classification of abnormal findings.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Collect the specimens from the face of the cervix and the endocervix using a spatula or brush
Appropriately label and transport the sample to the laboratory
Cytotechnologists in the laboratory process and interpret it

_derivation.explanation: Converted cytology process steps into a system workflow requirement.

functional_requirements.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Post-treatment follow-up workflow: schedule follow-up at 12 months or 1 year and route based on result.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to schedule and manage post-treatment follow-up
functional_requirements.so_that: recurrence or persistence is detected and managed
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can schedule follow-up at 12 months/1 year, record the follow-up result and route negative, positive and suspected cancer outcomes appropriately.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from post-treatment follow-up guidance and flowcharts.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: The first follow-up visit should be scheduled 1 year after treatment

section_path: Algorithm for Post-treatment Follow-up for the General Population of Women
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Follow up after 12 months with HPV test is recommended

_derivation.explanation: Merged follow-up timing and result-based routing into one requirement.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Special population workflow: support HIV-specific screening age, interval, triage and treatment pathways.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to support WLHIV-specific cervical screening pathways
functional_requirements.so_that: higher-risk clients are screened and managed according to guidance
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can apply age 25 initiation, HPV primary screening, shorter intervals, triage options and excision preference for CIN2+ in WLHIV.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / HIV and cervical screening programmes
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from WLHIV recommendations and service delivery table.

section_path: Recommendations for screening in special populations
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Screening should start at age 25 years ... with HPV test as the primary screening method.

section_path: Recommendations for screening in special populations
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Frequency of HPV testing is 5-yearly for HIV uninfected women but 3 yearly for HIV infected women

section_path: Recommendations for screening in special populations
_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Excision (LEEP or Cone Biopsy) is recommended to optimize cervical precancer treatment in this population.

_derivation.explanation: Combined HIV-specific screening, triage and treatment guidance into one capability.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Pregnancy and postpartum workflow: prevent treatment during pregnancy, allow screening in first trimester, and resume screening postpartum.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to handle pregnancy and postpartum screening rules
functional_requirements.so_that: clients are managed safely around pregnancy and delivery
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system blocks precancer treatment during pregnancy, allows first-trimester screening, and schedules postpartum rescreening at 6 weeks or 6 weeks post-delivery.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme
functional_requirements.notes: Derived from pregnancy and postpartum guidance.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Screening can be done in the first trimester (up to the end of week 12)
Treatment for precancerous lesion should NOT be performed during pregnancy
Cervical cancer screening should resume at 6 weeks after delivery

_derivation.explanation: Converted pregnancy/postpartum clinical constraints into workflow rules.

functional_requirements.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Disability-access workflow: ensure accessible facilities and communication support for women living with disability.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to capture accessibility and communication accommodations
functional_requirements.so_that: women living with disability can access screening services equitably
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system can record accessibility accommodations such as adjustable tables, mobility space, communication aids and sign-language interpreter needs.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Screening facilities must be accessible with adjustable examination tables and adequate space for mobility aids.
The healthcare provider should communicate clearly and with appropriate tools to ensure understanding.
deaf women, who may need sign language interpreters

_derivation.explanation: Converted accessibility guidance into a system support requirement.

functional_requirements.business_process_activity_id_and_descrip: Consent workflow: capture consent before ablation and document eligibility criteria for ablation.
functional_requirements.i_want: the system to record treatment consent and eligibility checks
functional_requirements.so_that: ablation is only performed when criteria are met
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system records consent and eligibility criteria before ablation and prevents proceeding when exclusion criteria are present.
functional_requirements.owner: Ministry of Health / cervical screening programme

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Women who have given consent for treatment
Women with a positive test and an entirely visible lesion on the ectocervix

_derivation.explanation: Converted eligibility and consent criteria into a system safeguard requirement.
